items.title: The top cokernel of a bounded above flat complex of finite tor amplitude is flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cokernel of the differential of a bounded above flat complex at the lower end of its tor amplitude interval is flat, and the proof is a 15-line argument that replaces the derived tensor product by an ordinary one and then reads flatness off the resulting exactness. It uses that a bounded above complex of flat modules computes its own derived tensor product, so the segment of the complex around the degree in question is exact in the middle after tensoring with any module, and concludes that the higher Tor of the cokernel vanishes; the flatness criterion of the Algebra chapter then gives the statement. The exactness input and the Tor computation are displayed.
